metadata.title: New Wave Band Portrait with Geometric Banner

recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five men in 1980s attire, processed with a heavy cyan-blue duotone tint and a visible halftone dot pattern. The composition features a bold, white sans-serif title at the top left and a contrasting red diagonal banner at the top right containing secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cool cyan-tinted photography and the warm red graphic banner
Hierarchy established by the large white block lettering against the darker background
Balance between the five figures arranged in a shallow depth of field
Texture consistency across the image through a fine mechanical halftone screen
coreInvariants: Diagonal red banner in the upper right corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged horizontally across the frame; the central and rightmost figures are in sharpest focus and largest scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white display text in the upper left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the white title at top-left, across to the red banner at top-right, then down through the faces of the group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the figures fill the lower two-thirds of the frame against a mottled, dark studio backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue duotone tint applied to the entire photographic area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black shadows providing depth and form.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used exclusively for the geometric banner in the upper right.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright white text and the dark, saturated cyan mid-tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and italicized humanist sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses uniform stroke weight and flat terminals
Secondary type is slanted with a moderate stroke contrast
Tight letter spacing (tracking) for the display title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, condensed uppercase display font with a light, italicized lowercase secondary font.
graphicDevices: Diagonal red banner with a sharp left-side point

preserve: Condensed nature of the main title
Lowercase italic style of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the primary title.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Gill Sans Italic or Frutiger Italic
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, humanist lowercase feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of five men in 80s fashion, styled in a cyan-blue duotone with a visible halftone dot texture. Leave the top 20% of the frame relatively dark for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large white condensed sans-serif title in the top left. Add a bright red diagonal banner in the top right corner and place lowercase italicized black text inside it.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across the entire photograph?
Is the red banner a distinct, saturated contrast to the cyan background?
Is the main title in all-caps condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the portrait

mustAchieve: Strong color-blocking between cyan and red

postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone pattern does not obscure facial features too much.
Ensure the red banner does not overlap the main white title.
Verify the duotone effect is strictly cyan/black without other colors leaking in.
Confirm the secondary text is entirely lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyan Duotone + Halftone Screen + Condensed White Display Type + Red Diagonal Accent Banner
